newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France injects 2.3 bln Ffr at tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France injects 2.3 bln Ffr at tender.

text.p: The Bank of France injected 2.3 billion francs at a securities repurchase tender held on Thursday to allocate funds for injection into the money market on Friday.
It accepted bids for 52.0 billion francs in new liquidity, 2.3 billion more than the 49.7 billion leaving the market on Friday when a previous pact expires. The new pact expires on February 7.
The Bank of France said it allocated 15.6 billion francs to bidders offering Treasury bills as collateral, satisfying 4.7 percent of such demand.
It allotted a further 36.4 billion to bidders putting up private paper, satisfying 15.4 percent of this demand.
